mechanism: Methylphenidate inhibits CYP2D6 metabolism of nortriptyline, increasing tricyclic antidepressant levels; both drugs have sympathomimetic and CNS stimulant effects that may be additive.
action: Monitor for increased nortriptyline toxicity (anticholinergic effects, arrhythmias, tremor); consider nortriptyline dose reduction or therapeutic drug monitoring; assess cardiac status given additive sympathomimetic effects.
